newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P assigns Westpac mortgage bonds ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Westpac mortgage bonds ratings.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said it has assigned its AAA and AA-minus rating on Westpac Banking Corp's series 1997-2 WST Trust's A$591.1 million class A senior notes and A$13.3 million class B subordinated notes.
This is the first public securitisation of mortgage loans by Westpac using its special purpose vehicle WST master trust structure.
"Increasingly, Australian banks are considering and exploring the benefits of securitisation as a viable funding alternative," S&P said.
"Standard & Poor's expects that this year there will be a high volume of transactions involving banks securitising their own assets," it added.
